description: Half-Life 2 style first-person hand sway for Minecraft (Fabric, client-side).

mods.name: Gordon's Grip
mods.description: Half-Life 2 style first-person hand sway: your hand lags behind when you look around, drifts in a lazy figure-eight as you walk, and shifts as you look up and down.

releases.notes:
First release. Half-Life 2 style hand sway for Minecraft 26.3 (Fabric, client-side).

- **Turn Lag**: your hand trails behind when you look around, then catches up.
- **Walk Sway**: a figure-eight drift while you walk, bigger when you sprint.
- **Look Shift**: your hand pulls in when you look down and reaches out when you look up.
- **Style**: Remembered (default: springy, stride-synced, HL2 as you remember it) or Source Accurate (a straight port of the Source SDK viewmodel math).
- **Vanilla Hand Bob** toggle, and a Mod Menu settings screen with Reset to Defaults.

Requires Fabric Loader 0.19.5+. Mod Menu optional. No Fabric API needed.
